checks.name: Other projects preserve exact argv and cwd without employee registration
Read-only help/version and explicit CLI management do not allocate workers
Two normal codex launches create distinct physical workspaces and preserve options
Explicit teammates and registered resume reuse the correct employee workspace
Write-boundary escapes, remote/profile overrides and unbound resume are rejected
A second managed launcher cannot acquire an employee already running
Bash installation preserves existing bytes and is idempotent and syntactically valid
Sourced codex Bash function invokes the original executable without recursion

limit: The fake CLI proves real process cwd/argv routing; native model calls/login were not executed
